calculation: For each method/visit/run, take the arithmetic mean of all 16 measured requests per phase, then the median across the three independent run means. Baseline range is max minus min of its three means. No trimming or percentage tolerance. Phase deltas need not sum to the latency delta because phase medians can select different runs.

monitor_review.recorded_evidence: Original driver/ledger retain per-run command, environment, PID, UTC start/end and exit status. Each accepted run retains hardware and post-request memory observations. The driver does not collect GPU-process telemetry. Coordinated quiet windows are operational records, not continuous process-attribution evidence.
monitor_review.scope_limit: No current trace-wide PID/UUID/clock/utilization or co-tenant exclusion audit is claimed. Hardware snapshots do not reconstruct missing time-series samples.

interpretation: Async first and revisit latency increases exceed the observed P0 three-run mean ranges and require investigation.

All three offload revisit admission ranges and all eight cleanup ranges lie above their corresponding P0 ranges. Offload revisit extend means decrease; those phase movements do not by themselves identify a causal code change.
